articles.summary: PHOENIX, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Trinity Capital Inc. (NYSE: TRIN) ("the Company"), a leading international alternative asset manager, today announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results at 8:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, November 4, 2026.
